name: TCM IDrive Index
description: Indexes one or more IDrive e2 S3 buckets (one bucket per subject) into a local SQLite store. Exposes openclaw tcm idrive ... CLI (sync/ls/tree/find/get/put/presign) plus idrive_find and idrive_put tools.

endpoint.description: IDrive e2 endpoint URL, e.g. https://s3.ap-northeast-1.idrivee2.com

subjectBuckets.description: Explicit list of subject buckets (one bucket per subject). Empty = auto-discover via ListBuckets.

excludeBuckets.description: Buckets to exclude from auto-discovery (e.g. your MCQ output bucket).

memoryDir.description: If set, drop folder-summary markdown files here for OpenClaw memory indexer.
